title: Respect employees' right to refuse out-of-hours contact
what: An employer must allow employees to refuse to monitor, read or respond to out-of-hours contact, unless refusing is unreasonable.

sources.title: Fair Work Act 2009
sources.quote: 333M Employee right to disconnect (1) An employee may refuse to monitor, read or respond to contact, or attempted contact, from an employer outside of the employee’s working hours unless the refusal is unreasonable.

confidence_note: The Act's own words give every employee the right; it has applied to small business employers since 26 August 2025.

assessment.summary: Employees may refuse unreasonable contact outside working hours. A workplace right aimed at wellbeing; for firms it adds policies and some coordination costs.

marks.reason: Employers need policies and practices to manage out-of-hours contact and disputes.
